articles.title_en: Multistage information transmission with voluntary monetary transfers
articles.title_cn: 带有自愿货币转移的多阶段信息传递
authors: Sadakane, Hitoshi (Institute of Economic Research, Kyoto University)
articles.abstract_en: We analyze a cheap-talk model in which an informed sender and an uninformed receiver engage in a finite-period communication before the receiver chooses a project. During the communication phase, the sender sends a message in each period, and the receiver then voluntarily pays money for the message. As in the canonical cheap-talk model, all the equilibria are interval partitional; in our setting, however, the set of equilibrium partitions becomes larger. We show that the multistage information transmission with voluntary monetary transfers can improve welfare if the receiver cares more about the decision and the sender cares more about money or if the ex-post sender--receiver incentive conflict over the project choice is small. We derive a multistage information elicitation mechanism without commitment that can be more beneficial to the receiver than a broad class of other communication protocols (e.g., mediation and arbitration).
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析一个廉价交谈模型，其中知情的发送者和不知情的接收者在接收者选择项目之前进行有限期沟通。在沟通阶段，发送者在每一期发送一条消息，然后接收者自愿为该消息支付货币。与经典廉价交谈模型一样，所有均衡都是区间分割的；然而在我们的设定中，均衡分割的集合变得更大。我们表明，如果接收者更关心决策且发送者更关心货币，或者如果事后发送者—接收者关于项目选择的激励冲突较小，那么带有自愿货币转移的多阶段信息传递可以改善福利。我们推导出一种无承诺的多阶段信息诱导机制，该机制可能比一大类其他沟通协议（例如，调解和仲裁）更有利于接收者。

authors: Grochulski, Borys (Research Department, Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond)
Zhang, Yuzhe (Department of Economics, Texas A&M University)
Borys Grochulski
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we study the conditions under which termination is a useful incentive device in the canonical dynamic principal-agent moral hazard model of Sannikov (2008). We find that temporary suspension of the agent after poor performance dominates termination if the principal's outside option is low and the agent's outside option is moderate. In suspension, the agent performs tasks free of moral hazard and receives no compensation, which rebuilds his "skin in the game" and allows for incentives to be restored without terminating. If the agent's outside option is low, suspension is ineffective because it rebuilds the agent's skin in the game too slowly. If the agent's outside option is high, the profitability of the relationship with the agent is low, so the principal prefers to terminate rather than extend the relationship through temporary suspension. Because the optimal use of suspension versus termination after poor performance can be highly sensitive to the principal's and agent's outside options, similar jobs can have vastly different average job durations, purely for incentive reasons.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们研究在Sannikov（2008）的经典动态委托-代理道德风险模型中，终止作为一种有用的激励手段的条件。我们发现，如果委托人的外部选项低且代理人的外部选项适中，那么在表现不佳后暂时中止代理人优于终止。在中止期间，代理人无道德风险地执行任务且不获得报酬，这重建了他的“利益攸关”，并使得激励得以恢复而无需终止。如果代理人的外部选项低，中止是无效的，因为它重建代理人利益攸关的速度太慢。如果代理人的外部选项高，与代理人关系的盈利能力低，因此委托人更倾向于终止而不是通过暂时中止来延长关系。由于在表现不佳后中止与终止的最优使用可能对委托人和代理人的外部选项高度敏感，类似的工作可能仅出于激励原因而具有截然不同的平均工作持续时间。

articles.title_en: Rationalizable implementation of social choice functions: complete characterization
articles.title_cn: 社会选择函数的可理性化实施：完整刻画
authors: Xiong, Siyang (Department of Economics, University of California, Riverside)
Siyang Xiong
articles.abstract_en: We provide a complete answer regarding what social choice functions can be rationalizably implemented.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了关于哪些社会选择函数可以被可理性化实施的完整答案。

articles.title_en: Optimal information structures in bilateral trade
articles.title_cn: 双边贸易中的最优信息结构
authors: Schottmüller, Christoph (Department of Economics, University of Cologne)
articles.abstract_en: With the goal of maximizing expected gains from trade, this paper analyzes the jointly optimal information structure and mechanism in a bilateral trade setting. The difference in gains from trade between the optimal information structure and first best constitutes the minimal loss due to asymmetric information. With binary underlying types it is shown that more than 95% of first best can be achieved while the optimal mechanism without information design may achieve less than 90% of first best. For more general type distributions, the optimal information structure is a monotone partition of the type space and the optimal mechanism is deterministic. Necessary conditions for the optimal information structure are derived and a closed form solution is given for the binary type case.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文以最大化贸易期望收益为目标，分析了双边贸易环境中的联合最优信息结构与机制。最优信息结构与第一最优之间的贸易收益差异构成了因不对称信息导致的最小损失。在二元基础类型下，研究表明可实现超过第一最优的95%，而在没有信息设计的情况下，最优机制可能实现不到第一最优的90%。对于更一般的类型分布，最优信息结构是类型空间的单调划分，且最优机制是确定性的。推导了最优信息结构的必要条件，并给出了二元类型情形下的闭式解。

articles.title_en: Robust comparative statics for the elasticity of intertemporal substitution
articles.title_cn: 跨期替代弹性的稳健比较静态
authors: Flynn, Joel P. (Department of Economics, Massachusetts Institute of Technology)
Schmidt, Lawrence D. W. (Sloan School of Management, Massachusetts Institute of Technology)
Toda, Alexis Akira (Department of Economics, University of California San Diego)
Joel Peter Flynn
Lawrence David Warren Schmidt
Alexis Akira Toda
articles.abstract_en: We study a general class of consumption-savings problems with recursive preferences. We characterize the sign of the consumption response to arbitrary shocks in terms of the product of two sufficient statistics: the elasticity of intertemporal substitution between contemporaneous consumption and continuation utility (EIS), and the relative elasticity of the marginal value of wealth (REMV). Under homotheticity, the REMV always equals one, so the propensity of the agent to save or dis-save is always signed by the relationship of the EIS with unity. We apply our results to derive comparative statics in classical problems of portfolio allocation, consumption-savings with income risk, and entrepreneurial investment. Our results suggest empirical identification strategies for both the value of the EIS and its relationship with unity.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究一类具有递归偏好的消费-储蓄问题。我们以两个充分统计量的乘积来刻画消费对任意冲击的响应符号：当期消费与延续效用之间的跨期替代弹性（EIS），以及财富边际价值的相对弹性（REMV）。在齐次性下，REMV 始终等于 一，因此代理人储蓄或负储蓄的倾向始终由 EIS 与 1 的关系决定符号。我们将结果应用于推导投资组合配置、带收入风险的消费-储蓄以及企业家投资等经典问题中的比较静态。我们的结果提出了对 EIS 取值及其与 1 关系的实证识别策略。

articles.title_en: Innovation, firm size distribution, and gains from trade
articles.title_cn: 创新、企业规模分布与贸易收益
authors: Chen, Yi-Fan (National University of Kaohsiung)
Hsu, Wen-Tai (Institute of Economics, Academia Sinica)
Peng, Shin-Kun (Institute of Economics, Academia Sinica)
articles.abstract_en: Power laws in productivity and firm size are well-documented empirical regularities. As they are upper right-tail phenomena, this paper shows that assuming asymptotic power functions for various model primitives (such as demand and firm heterogeneity) are sufficient for matching these regularities. This greatly relaxes the functional-form restrictions in economic modeling and can be beneficial in certain contexts. We demonstrate this in a modified Melitz (2003) model which embeds an innovation mechanism in order to endogenize the productivity distribution and generate both of the above-mentioned power laws. We also investigate the model's welfare implications with regard to innovation by conducting a quantitative analysis of the welfare gains from trade.
articles.abstract_cn: 生产率与企业规模中的幂律是已被充分记录的经验规律。由于它们是上右尾现象，本文表明，对各种模型基本要素（如需求和企业异质性）假设渐近幂函数足以匹配这些规律。这极大地放松了经济建模中的函数形式限制，并在某些情境下可能是有益的。我们在一个修改的Melitz（2003）模型中展示了这一点，该模型嵌入了创新机制，以将生产率分布内生化并生成上述两种幂律。我们还通过进行贸易福利收益的定量分析，考察了该模型关于创新的福利含义。

authors: Bernheim, B. Douglas (Department of Economics, Stanford University)
Bodoh-Creed, Aaron L. (Amazon)
articles.abstract_en: How does the increasing publicness of decisions (due, for example, to social media) affect the total costs of social signaling distortions? While pervasive signaling may induce pervasive distortions, it may also permit people to signal while distorting each choice to a smaller degree. Ironically, for a broad class of environments, a sufficient increase in the number of signaling opportunities allows senders to ``live authentically'' -- that is, to signal their types at arbitrarily low overall cost. This result survives when social networking technologies expand signaling opportunities and audience size in tandem, provided the returns to the latter are not too great.
articles.abstract_cn: 决策日益公开（例如由于社交媒体）如何影响社会信号扭曲的总成本？虽然普遍信号传递可能引发普遍扭曲，但它也可能允许人们在扭曲每个选择程度较小的情况下进行信号传递。具有讽刺意味的是，对于一大类环境，信号传递机会数量的充分增加允许发送者“真实地生活”——即以任意低的总体成本传递其类型。当社交网络技术同步扩大信号传递机会和受众规模时，只要后者的回报不太大，这一结果依然成立。

articles.title_cn: 通过双池化的最优说服
authors: Arieli, Itai (Technion–Israel Institute of Technology)
Babichenko, Yakov (Technion–Israel Institute of Technology)
Smorodinsky, Rann (Technion–Israel Institute of Technology)
Yamashita, Takuro (Toulouse School of Economics, University of Toulouse Capitole)
Takuro Yamashita
articles.abstract_en: Mean-preserving contractions are critical for studying Bayesian models of information design. We introduce the class of bi-pooling policies, and the class of bi-pooling distributions as their induced distributions over posteriors. We show that every extreme point in the set of all mean-preserving contractions of any given prior over an interval takes the form of a bi-pooling distribution. By implication, every Bayesian persuasion problem with an interval state-space admits an optimal bi-pooling distribution as a solution, and conversely, for every bi-pooling distribution, there is a Bayesian persuasion problem for which that distribution is the unique solution
articles.abstract_cn: 均值保持收缩对于研究信息设计的贝叶斯模型至关重要。我们引入双池化策略类，以及作为其后验诱导分布的双池化分布类。我们证明，对于任意给定先验在区间上的所有均值保持收缩的集合中的每一个极点，都采取双池化分布的形式。由此推论，任何具有区间状态空间的贝叶斯说服问题都允许一个最优双池化分布作为解，反之，对于每一个双池化分布，都存在一个贝叶斯说服问题，使得该分布是该问题的唯一解。

articles.title_en: On the neutrality of socially responsible investing
articles.title_cn: 论社会责任投资的中性
authors: Arnold, Lutz G. (Department of Economics, University of Regensburg)
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the conditions under which socially responsible investment (SRI) is neutral from the viewpoint of general equilibrium theory. Three conditions are jointly sufficient for neutrality of SRI. First, the financial market is complete and SRI does not compromise the spanning opportunities it provides. Second, consumers' rankings of consumption bundles are unaffected by their asset holdings. Third, firms maximize shareholder value. Under an additional assumption that is satisfied, e.g., if SRI takes the form of negative screening, the taxes and transfers needed to implement a Pareto-optimal allocation are the same as in the absence of SRI. SRI is neutral despite financial market incompleteness if there are perfect substitutes for targeted stocks.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文从一般均衡理论的视角考察社会责任投资（SRI）保持中性的条件。三个条件共同构成SRI中性的充分条件。第一，金融市场是完全的，且SRI不损害其提供的跨期配置机会。第二，消费者对消费束的排序不受其资产持有的影响。第三，企业最大化股东价值。在一个得到满足的额外假设下，例如，如果SRI采取负面筛选的形式，那么实施帕累托最优配置所需的税收和转移支付与不存在SRI时相同。尽管金融市场不完全，如果目标股票存在完全替代品，SRI仍是中性的。

articles.title_en: Additive valuations of streams of payoffs that satisfy the time value of money principle: characterization and robust optimization
articles.title_cn: 满足货币时间价值原理的收益流的可加估值：刻画与稳健优化
authors: Neyman, Abraham (Federmann Center for the Study of Rationality, Hebrew University of Jerusalem)
articles.abstract_en: This paper characterizes those preferences over bounded infinite utility streams that satisfy the time value of money principle and an additivity property, and the subset of these preferences that in addition are either impatient or patient. Based on this characterization, the paper introduces a concept of optimization that is robust to a small imprecision in the specification of the preference, and proves that the set of feasible streams of payoffs of a finite Markov decision process admits such a robust optimization.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文刻画了那些在有界无限效用流上满足货币时间价值原理和可加性性质的偏好，以及这些偏好中额外属于不耐烦或耐心的子集。基于这一刻画，本文引入了一种对偏好设定中的微小不精确性具有稳健性的优化概念，并证明了有限马尔可夫决策过程的可行收益流集合允许这种稳健优化。

articles.title_en: Stable matching: an integer programming approach
articles.title_cn: 稳定匹配：一种整数规划方法
authors: Huang, Chao (Institute for Social and Economic Research, Nanjing Audit University)
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops an integer programming approach to two-sided many-to-one matching by investigating stable integral matchings of a fictitious market where each worker is divisible. We show that stable matching exists in a discrete matching market when firms' preference profile satisfies a unimodularity condition that is compatible with various forms of complementarities. We provide a class of firms' preference profiles that satisfy the unimodularity condition.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过研究一个每个工人可分割的虚拟市场中的稳定整数匹配，发展了一种用于双边多对一匹配的整数规划方法。我们表明，当企业的偏好轮廓满足一个与各种形式的互补性相容的单模性条件时，离散匹配市场中存在稳定匹配。我们提供了一类满足该单模性条件的企业偏好轮廓。

articles.title_en: On guarantees, vetoes and random dictators
articles.title_cn: 论保证、否决权与随机独裁者
authors: Bogomolnaia, Anna (Adam Smith Business School University of Glasgow and CNRS Centre d'Economie de la Sorbonne)
Holzman, Ron (Department of Mathematics, Technion-Israel Institute of Technology)
Moulin, Hervé (Adam Smith Business School, University of Glasgow)
Anna Bogomolnaia
Herve Moulin
articles.abstract_en: A mechanism guarantees a certain welfare level to its agents, if each of them can secure that level against unanimously adversarial others. How high can such a guarantee be, and what type of mechanism achieves it? In the n-person probabilistic voting/bargaining model with p deterministic outcomes a guarantee takes the form of a probability distribution over the ranks from 1 to p. authors: Segal, Uzi (Department of Economics, Boston College)
articles.abstract_en: This paper shows that in some axioms regarding the mixture of random variables, the requirement that the conclusions hold for all values of the mixture parameter can be replaced by requiring the existence of only one non-trivial value of the parameter, which needs not be fixed. This is the case for the independence, betweenness, and the mixture symmetry axioms. Unlike the standard axioms, these weaker versions cannot be refuted by experimental methods.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文表明，在一些关于随机变量混合的公理中，结论对所有混合参数值成立的要求，可以替换为只要求存在一个非平凡的参数值，且该值无需固定。独立性、中间性和混合对称性公理均属此情形。与标准公理不同，这些较弱版本无法通过实验方法被反驳。

authors: Escudé, Matteo (Department of Economics and Finance, LUISS)
Sinander, Ludvig (Department of Economics and Nuffield College, University of Oxford)
Matteo Escude
articles.abstract_en: What are the value and form of optimal persuasion when information can be generated only slowly? We study this question in a dynamic model in which a `sender' provides public information over time subject to a graduality constraint, and a decision-maker takes an action in each period. Using a novel `viscosity' dynamic programming principle, we characterise the sender's equilibrium value function and information provision. We show that the graduality constraint inhibits information provision relative to unconstrained persuasion. The gap can be substantial, but closes as the constraint slackens. Contrary to unconstrained persuasion, less-than-full information may be provided even if players have aligned preferences but different prior beliefs.
articles.abstract_cn: 当信息只能缓慢生成时，最优说服的价值和形式是什么？我们在一个动态模型中研究这个问题，其中“发送者”在渐进性约束下随时间提供公共信息，而决策者在每一期采取行动。使用一种新颖的“粘性”动态规划原理，我们刻画了发送者的均衡价值函数和信息提供。我们表明，相对于无约束说服，渐进性约束抑制了信息提供。这一差距可能很大，但随着约束放松而缩小。与无约束说服相反，即使参与者偏好一致但先验信念不同，也可能提供少于完全的信息。
